tools.name: add_cardio_entry
tools.summary: Records cardio done without a watch: a day, minutes and an activity type.

tools.name: add_client_event
tools.summary: Adds a date to a client's timeline, such as a show, a photoshoot or a holiday.

tools.name: add_client_note
tools.summary: Adds a note on a client.

tools.name: add_meal
tools.summary: Adds a meal to a meal plan.

tools.name: add_meal_option
tools.summary: Adds a dish to a meal: a copy of a recipe scaled to servings, foods, or numbers entered by hand.

tools.name: add_workout_to_program
tools.summary: Puts a copy of a library workout, or a new empty workout, on a day of a week.

tools.name: apply_sequence
tools.summary: Enrolls a client.

tools.name: archive_automation_rule
tools.summary: Archives an automation and stops its enrollments.

tools.name: assign_form_to_clients
tools.summary: Assigns one form to up to 100 clients on the same schedule and notifies each.

tools.name: assign_habits
tools.summary: Gives a client up to 20 habits at once.

tools.name: assign_plan_set
tools.summary: Copies a plan set's plans into a client and replaces the client's day-type setup.

tools.name: assign_program
tools.summary: Puts a program on the client: copies its workouts onto dates (Calendar, day 1 of the chosen week falls on startDate) or onto the end of the list (Fixed).

tools.name: bulk_update_tasks
tools.summary: Updates many tasks at once.

tools.name: check_client_email
tools.summary: Reports whether an email is new, a client here, or already on the team.

tools.name: choose_meal_option
tools.summary: Picks an option, or a recipe with servings, for a meal on one date.

tools.name: clear_day_override
tools.summary: Removes the override on one date so training and rules decide again.

tools.name: compare_checkins
tools.summary: Puts 2 to 4 sent check-ins side by side by question key, with the change from first to last and the photos per pose.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.summary: Marks a task done.

tools.name: confirm_food_log_draft
tools.summary: Saves a text draft as entries.

tools.name: copy_food_log
tools.summary: Copies a day's entries, or only the listed meals, to another date as new entries.

tools.name: create_automation_rule
tools.summary: Saves an automation as a draft.

tools.name: create_client
tools.summary: Adds a client with access invite or later.

tools.name: create_day_type
tools.summary: Creates a company day type such as Legs or High carb.

tools.name: create_nutrition_plan
tools.summary: Creates a meal or macros plan for a client, empty or as a copy of another of their plans.

tools.name: create_program
tools.summary: Creates a Calendar or Fixed program with one empty first week.

tools.name: create_task
tools.summary: Creates a task for the company.

tools.name: create_workout
tools.summary: Creates a library workout (or a section template with ownerKind section) from blocks of lines and sets.

tools.name: delete_food_log_entry
tools.summary: Deletes one entry.

tools.name: delete_metric_entry
tools.summary: Deletes one day's entry.

tools.name: delete_session
tools.summary: Deletes a session and recomputes the records it affected.

tools.name: draft_checkin_feedback
tools.summary: Saves feedback on a sent check-in as a draft for the coach.

tools.name: edit_client_workout
tools.summary: Saves this client's copy of a workout as a new revision and marks it customised.

tools.name: find_clients_missing_habits
tools.summary: Lists clients whose habit completion over the last days is below a percentage, lowest first.

tools.name: finish_call
tools.summary: Finishes a call.

tools.name: flag_for_call
tools.summary: Adds something to the client's next call: a check-in answer, a message, a chart point, a food day or a note.

tools.name: get_activity_summary
tools.summary: Returns a client's steps, active energy, sleep, resting heart rate and workouts for a week or month, each compared with the period before, and the cardio minutes and sessions per week from watch workouts, Evolvix training and entries.

tools.name: get_automation
tools.summary: Returns one automation and its steps.

tools.name: get_call_brief
tools.summary: Returns the agenda of a call with a client as data: the header, what changed since the last call, the latest check-in with the answers that moved most, adherence, open questions, flagged items and the last call's agreements.

tools.name: get_checkin
tools.summary: Returns one check-in with the questions of its revision, the answers, comments and feedback.

tools.name: get_checkin_question_trend
tools.summary: Returns one question's answers across a form's sent check-ins, oldest first.

tools.name: get_checkin_week
tools.summary: Returns a daily check-in form as a week grid: a row per question, a cell per day, and per question the week's average, most common answer or count set against the week before.

tools.name: get_client
tools.summary: Returns one client, including status, coaches, profile, and week.

tools.name: get_client_overview
tools.summary: Reads one client's overview for a date and a week.

tools.name: get_client_timeline
tools.summary: Returns a client's timeline: the phases that touch the range and the events inside it, and where the client stands today.

tools.name: get_client_workout
tools.summary: Returns one client workout with its full document: blocks, lines, sets, and alternatives.

tools.name: get_coach_today
tools.summary: Reads the coach's today page for one company.

tools.name: get_day_calendar
tools.summary: Returns the client's resolved day types for a date range: the type, the fallback chain nutrition uses, and why.

tools.name: get_day_rules
tools.summary: Returns the weekday and date rules used on days training does not decide.

tools.name: get_exercise_history
tools.summary: Returns one exercise's history: best weight, estimated 1RM, volume and session tiles, a chart series per day with record markers, and the set log per session.

tools.name: get_fixed_program
tools.summary: Returns a Fixed client's workouts in order with done, next, upcoming, or skipped, which one is next up, and sessions done outside the list.

tools.name: get_food_log
tools.summary: Returns one day's food log: entries, totals, per-meal groups, the day's snapshot target, the note, skips, and choices.

tools.name: get_grocery_list
tools.summary: Returns the grocery list for a date range: foods from each day's meal plan summed with units, grouped by shop category, with ticks and the client's own items.

tools.name: get_habit_summary
tools.summary: Returns the week table: one row per habit, one cell per day, plus the average.

tools.name: get_me
tools.summary: Returns the signed-in profile.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.summary: Lists a page of messages in a relationship, oldest first within the page.

tools.name: get_metric_trend
tools.summary: Returns one metric's entries, open goal, and summary: first, last, change, percent change, average, and previousAverage.

tools.name: get_metric_week
tools.summary: Returns the week table: every tracked metric by day, the week's average, and the change from the week before.

tools.name: get_nutrition_day
tools.summary: Returns one day's nutrition: the day type, which plan applies after fallback, the target, and the meals.

tools.name: get_nutrition_plan
tools.summary: Returns a plan with every food, unit, and nutrient per line, dish, meal, and day, compared with the client's targets.

tools.name: get_nutrition_settings
tools.summary: Returns how the client logs food and what nutrition features they see.

tools.name: get_nutrition_setup
tools.summary: Returns the nutrition pattern for a relationship.

tools.name: get_nutrition_summary
tools.summary: Returns the last days up to today with the day type, the target the client saw, and what was logged, plus averages over logged days.

tools.name: get_program
tools.summary: Returns a program with its settings, weeks, and placed workouts (name, counts, day type, estimated duration) and the revision to send back.

tools.name: get_session
tools.summary: Returns one session with its exercises, sets, previous performance, current records, and the records it set.

tools.name: get_todays_habits
tools.summary: Returns the habits due today in the client's time zone, with state, amount and streak.

tools.name: get_training_calendar
tools.summary: Returns each date of a range (at most 62 days) with its day type, its client workouts, and the sessions performed.

tools.name: get_training_stats
tools.summary: Returns training statistics for a period against the equal period before: KPIs, weighted sets per muscle, daily upper, lower, and core sets, a trained-day calendar, and record cards.

tools.name: import_clients
tools.summary: Adds up to 200 clients.

tools.name: import_metric_history
tools.summary: Imports up to 2000 dated measurements for one client, such as daily weights from a spreadsheet.

tools.name: list_automation_actions
tools.summary: Lists the actions an automation can run.

tools.name: list_automation_templates
tools.summary: Lists sequence templates a coach can start from.

tools.name: list_automation_triggers
tools.summary: Lists the events that can start an automation.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.summary: Lists automations in the company.

tools.name: list_chat_references
tools.summary: Lists what a message can point at, one type at a time.

tools.name: list_checkin_assignments
tools.summary: Lists the forms assigned to a client with their schedule, next due check-in and compliance.

tools.name: list_checkin_inbox

tools.name: list_client_checkins
tools.summary: Lists a client's check-ins newest first.

tools.name: list_client_enrollments
tools.summary: Lists automations enrolled for one client.

tools.name: list_client_metrics
tools.summary: Lists the metrics a client tracks with the latest value and open goal.

tools.name: list_client_notes
tools.summary: Lists staff notes on a client, including private ones.

tools.name: list_client_tags
tools.summary: Lists the company's client tags and how many clients use each.

tools.name: list_clients

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.summary: Lists conversations with unread counts for the signed-in person.

tools.name: list_day_types
tools.summary: Lists day types: the built-in training and rest plus the company's own.

tools.name: list_enrollments
tools.summary: Lists clients enrolled in one automation.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.summary: Lists the company's check-in and questionnaire forms with question count and active assignments.

tools.name: list_habit_templates
tools.summary: Lists habit templates: the company's own and the platform's, with how many clients use each.

tools.name: list_missed_checkins
tools.summary: Lists check-ins whose window closed unsent in the last 30 days, most overdue first.

tools.name: list_my_due_checkins
tools.summary: Lists the signed-in client's open and upcoming check-ins across their open coaching relationships, soonest first.

tools.name: list_my_relationships
tools.summary: Lists the open coaching relationships of the signed-in person, with the enabled modules of each.

tools.name: list_nutrition_plans
tools.summary: Lists a client's nutrition plans with planned totals, option ranges, and the day types that use each.

tools.name: list_performed_exercises
tools.summary: Lists the exercises the client has logged, most recent first, with the last date and the number of sessions.

tools.name: list_personal_records
tools.summary: Returns the current record of each kind per exercise, and with exerciseId every record event too.

tools.name: list_plan_sets
tools.summary: Lists plan sets: library plans and targets per day type, assigned together.

tools.name: list_practices
tools.summary: Lists practices in the caller's company.

tools.name: list_program_assignments
tools.summary: Lists the programs on the client with their dates, status, and how many of their workouts are done.

tools.name: list_programs
tools.summary: Lists the programs of your company with week, workout, and assigned-client counts, plus shared samples when asked.

tools.name: list_saved_replies
tools.summary: Lists personal and shared saved replies for the caller.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.summary: Lists the client's workout sessions, newest first, with sets, volume, difficulty, and the number of records each set.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.summary: Lists tasks the caller can see, with overdue, today, upcoming, and no-date counts.

tools.name: list_team
tools.summary: Lists teammates with status, client count, last activity, and pending invitations.

tools.name: list_workouts
tools.summary: Lists library workouts (or section templates) of your company and the shared samples, with filters and a total.

tools.name: log_food
tools.summary: Logs foods, recipes, or quick adds to one meal.

tools.name: log_food_from_text
tools.summary: Turns a description such as "2 eggs, toast and coffee" into a draft of matched foods.

tools.name: log_habit
tools.summary: Logs a habit for one day.

tools.name: log_metrics
tools.summary: Logs several metrics for one day in one call.

tools.name: log_planned_meal
tools.summary: Logs a plan meal as eaten: every line of the day's chosen option, or the default option when none was chosen, scaled by portion from 0.25 to 2.

tools.name: log_workout
tools.summary: Logs a finished workout after the fact in one call: exercises with the sets as performed, all counted as done.

tools.name: mark_checkins_reviewed
tools.summary: Marks up to 100 sent check-ins as reviewed, or back to pending with reviewed false.

tools.name: mark_conversation_read
tools.summary: Moves the caller's read marker to a message in this conversation.

tools.summary: Sends one message from the caller into each client's conversation and notifies the client like a chat message.

tools.name: move_workout
tools.summary: Moves a workout to another date (Calendar) or place (Fixed).

tools.name: pause_client

tools.summary: Repeats the chosen workouts on the same weekday for the next weeks, each week a step further: more weight, reps, sets, or RPE, with an optional deload week.

tools.name: periodise_program
tools.summary: Copies selected workouts forward week by week, progressing weight, reps, sets, effort, and deloads.

tools.name: preview_client_import
tools.summary: Classifies import rows without writing them.

tools.name: publish_automation_rule

tools.name: remove_program_from_client
tools.summary: Takes a program off the client from a date on.

tools.name: reopen_checkin_due
tools.summary: Opens a missed or skipped check-in again until the end of closesOn.

tools.name: resend_invitation

tools.name: resume_client
tools.summary: Resumes a paused client back to active.

tools.name: save_checkin_answers

tools.name: schedule_workout

tools.name: search_exercises
tools.summary: Searches the shared Evolvix exercises and your company's own by a substring of the name, sorted A to Z, with no relevance ranking.

tools.name: search_foods
tools.summary: Searches the food catalog: shared foods plus your company's.

tools.name: search_log_foods
tools.summary: Searches the foods this client can log: shared foods plus the company's.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.summary: Searches recipes: your company's and the shared Evolvix set, with kcal and protein per serving.

tools.name: send_client_invitation
tools.summary: Emails an invitation to an invited client who has none, such as one added with access later.

tools.name: send_message
tools.summary: Sends a chat message.

tools.name: set_client_phase
tools.summary: Adds a phase to a client's timeline, or with phaseId changes that phase.

tools.name: set_daily_targets
tools.summary: Sets one day type's calories and macros, or attaches mealPlanId, and keeps the other day types, their plans, and the weekday rules.

tools.name: set_day_override
tools.summary: Sets the day type of one date, overriding training and rules.

tools.name: set_day_rules
tools.summary: Replaces all weekday and date rules.

tools.name: set_everyday_targets
tools.summary: Sets the same targets for every day.

tools.name: set_metric_goal
tools.summary: Sets the goal for one metric with a start and goal date.

tools.name: set_nutrition_setup
tools.summary: Replaces the nutrition pattern for a relationship.

tools.name: skip_workout

tools.name: snooze_attention
tools.summary: Snoozes one attention reason for 1, 3, or 7 days.

tools.name: start_call
tools.summary: Starts a call with a client, or a check-in review with mode review, and returns it.

tools.name: start_checkin
tools.summary: Opens a draft for a due check-in, or an extra one on a form that allows it.

tools.name: stop_enrollment

tools.name: submit_checkin

tools.name: suggest_targets

tools.name: tag_clients
tools.summary: Adds and removes tags on many clients.

tools.name: test_automation_rule
tools.summary: Previews runs due in the next 14 days.

tools.name: unlog_habit
tools.summary: Removes the log of one day.

tools.name: unskip_workout
tools.summary: Puts a skipped workout back on the calendar.

tools.name: update_automation_rule
tools.summary: Replaces an automation that is not archived, and leaving out the trigger, anchor, or settings resets them.

tools.name: update_checkin_schedule
tools.summary: Changes an assignment's schedule.

tools.name: update_client
tools.summary: Updates a client's names, dates, practice, or email.

tools.name: update_food_log_entry
tools.summary: Changes one entry.

tools.name: update_habit
tools.summary: Updates a habit.

tools.name: update_meal_option
tools.summary: Edits a dish: name, servings, foods, steps, or numbers by hand.

tools.name: update_task
tools.summary: Updates a task.
